user.title: Heating Assistant – Site Settings
user.description: Configure the basic settings for Heating Assistant. Room and heat source definitions are provided in configuration.yaml or can be configured after setup.

data.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature sensor (optional if weather forecast is available)
data.weather_entity: Weather forecast (optional; either this or outdoor temperature sensor is needed)
data.update_interval: How often to recalculate heating control (seconds, 60–3600)

data.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature sensor (optional if weather forecast is set)
data.weather_entity: Weather forecast (optional; one of these is required)
data.update_interval: Control update interval (seconds, 60–3600) — how often the system recalculates heating
data.sigma_w: System model flexibility (K/√s) — higher allows faster adaptation to changing conditions
data.sigma_v: Temperature sensor accuracy (K) — higher reflects less accurate sensors
data.sigma_b: Sensor drift compensation (K/√s) — higher allows calibration changes over time
data.window_open_debounce: Window open confirmation time (seconds) — how long a window must stay open to activate window mode
data.window_open_close_settle: Window close confirmation time (seconds) — how long a window must stay closed to exit window mode
data.window_open_q_inflation: Window-open uncertainty level — higher makes the system more cautious when windows are open

data.horizon: Prediction time horizon (steps) — higher looks further ahead (100 steps ≈ 25 hours at 15-min intervals)
data.tracking_weight: Target temperature priority (0–∞) — 0 = comfort band only, higher = keep closer to setpoint
data.energy_weight: Energy cost priority (0–∞) — higher values reduce heating costs but may sacrifice comfort
data.smoothing_weight: Comfort smoothing (0–∞) — higher prevents rapid heating/cooling cycles
data.soft_constraint_weight: Comfort band enforcement (0–∞) — higher strictly enforces staying in the comfort temperature range
data.terminal_weight: End-of-window behavior (1–10000) — how much to prioritize state at the end of prediction

data.name: Room name
data.envelope_tightness: Building air tightness — how much heat is lost through air leaks and wind

data.name: Room name
data.envelope_tightness: Building air tightness — how much heat is lost through air leaks and wind

data.orientation: Which direction does it face? (compass direction)

data.name: Heat source name
data.cop_rated: Rated COP at reference temperature (heat pumps only — higher is more efficient)
data.cop_temp_ref: Reference outdoor temperature for COP rating (°C, heat pumps only)
data.min_power: Minimum power output (watts, heat pumps only) — 0 = no minimum
data.max_temp_offset: Maximum temperature offset for power control (°C, heat pumps only)
data.hvac_mode: Operating mode (heat pumps only — heat only, cool only, or heat & cool)
data.emitter_time_constant: Response time delay (seconds) — radiators ~600s, fan coils ~60s, resistive heaters ~0s

error.duplicate_room: A room with this name already exists.

simulate_thermal_response.name: Simulate thermal response
simulate_thermal_response.description: Run a standalone thermal simulation showing how a room responds to constant heating power.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Name of the room to simulate.

heating_power.name: Heating power
heating_power.description: Constant thermal power applied to the room (W).

set_schedule_enabled.name: Suspend or resume comfort schedule
set_schedule_enabled.description: Suspend or resume the comfort schedule for a room (or all rooms when none is specified). Useful for one-off exceptions to a sleep / setback schedule.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Optional room name. Leave blank to apply to all rooms.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: True to resume the schedule, false to suspend it.

estimate_parameters.name: Estimate thermal parameters
estimate_parameters.description: Back-calculate thermal_mass and r_external from an observed heating experiment.

heating_power.name: Heating power
heating_power.description: Constant thermal power applied during the experiment (W).

initial_temp.name: Initial temperature
initial_temp.description: Room temperature at the start of the experiment (°C).

final_temp.name: Final temperature
final_temp.description: Room temperature at the end of the experiment (°C).

regenerate_dashboard.name: Regenerate Lovelace dashboard
regenerate_dashboard.description: Build a complete per-room Lovelace dashboard from the current Heating Assistant configuration. Returns the YAML in the response and optionally writes it to <config>/dashboards/.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return YAML only, do not write a file or create a notification.

filename.name: Output filename
filename.description: Plain filename (no path) inside <config>/dashboards. Defaults to heating_assistant.yaml.

compute_loglik_slice.name: Compute log-likelihood slice
compute_loglik_slice.description: Evaluate the CD-EKF PED log-likelihood on a (log C, log R_ext) grid centred on the room's current MLE. Drives the Diagnostics dashboard's likelihood-landscape card.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Room whose parameters should be sliced.

n_grid.name: Grid points
n_grid.description: Number of grid points per axis (odd preferred).

span_log.name: Half-width (log)
span_log.description: Half-width of the slice in log-units. 1.0 ≈ factor 2.7.
